conditions: Applies to the default behavior of the signed, opposite-sign, nonexact division described in §3.2.2.1.
limitations: This does not change Core words whose entries specify their own rounding behavior or assert a particular system default.

triggers: Evidence correction, scope change, or contrary primary material.

statement: The dated Forth 2012 draft makes the default quotient rounding direction implementation-defined for signed integer division with opposite-sign operands and a nonzero remainder. It describes floored division toward negative infinity and symmetric division toward zero.
